# An org module follows a branch head, so its next commit can require a module
# that the main module's go.mod and go.sum do not list yet. The org vetted that
# requirement, so a build without an explicit -mod flag records it: the
# indirect require line at the declared version, and go.sum lines verified
# against the checksum database. Nothing else relaxes -mod=readonly.

[short] skip 'constructs local git repositories'
[!git] skip

env GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=$WORK${/}home${/}gopher${/}.gitconfig
env HOME=$WORK${/}home${/}gopher
env GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL=file
env GOPRIVATE=github.com/wow-look-at-my
[!GOOS:windows] exec git config --global 'url.file://'$WORK'/alpha.insteadOf' 'https://github.com/wow-look-at-my/alpha'
[GOOS:windows]  exec git config --global 'url.file:///'$WORK'/alpha.insteadOf' 'https://github.com/wow-look-at-my/alpha'

env GIT_AUTHOR_NAME='Go Gopher'
env GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL='gopher@golang.org'
env GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=$GIT_AUTHOR_NAME
env GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=$GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL

cd $WORK/alpha
exec git init
env GIT_AUTHOR_DATE=2026-01-02T03:04:05Z
env GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=2026-01-02T03:04:05Z
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'alpha on quote v1.5.1'
exec git branch -m main

# The consumer lists alpha and nothing alpha needs, and has no go.sum. A plain
# build records alpha's requirements and succeeds.
cd $WORK/m
go build ./...
! stderr 'updates to go.mod needed'
! stderr 'missing go.sum entry'
grep '^	rsc.io/quote v1.5.1 // indirect$' go.mod
grep '^	rsc.io/sampler v1.3.0 // indirect$' go.mod
grep '^	golang.org/x/text v0.0.0-20170915032832-14c0d48ead0c // indirect$' go.mod
grep '^rsc.io/quote v1.5.1 h1:' go.sum
grep '^rsc.io/quote v1.5.1/go.mod h1:' go.sum
! grep 'wow-look-at-my' go.sum

# The recorded files are complete, so the next build writes nothing.
cp go.mod $WORK/m.go.mod
cp go.sum $WORK/m.go.sum
go build ./...
cmp go.mod $WORK/m.go.mod
cmp go.sum $WORK/m.go.sum

# The next alpha commit raises its quote requirement. The next build follows it.
cd $WORK/alpha
cp $WORK${/}alpha-next${/}go.mod go.mod
env GIT_AUTHOR_DATE=2026-01-03T04:05:06Z
env GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=2026-01-03T04:05:06Z
exec git commit -am 'alpha on quote v1.5.2'

cd $WORK/m
go build ./...
grep '^	rsc.io/quote v1.5.2 // indirect$' go.mod
! grep 'rsc.io/quote v1.5.1' go.mod
grep '^rsc.io/quote v1.5.2 h1:' go.sum

# go mod tidy agrees with what the build recorded.
cp go.mod $WORK/m2.go.mod
go mod tidy
cmp go.mod $WORK/m2.go.mod

# An explicit -mod=readonly keeps its upstream meaning.
cd $WORK/strict
! go build -mod=readonly ./...
stderr 'missing go.sum entry|updates to go.mod needed'
! grep 'rsc.io/quote' go.mod

# A module that no org module declares is not recorded. A missing import still
# fails the way it does upstream.
cd $WORK/direct
! go build ./...
stderr 'no required module provides package rsc.io/fortune'
! grep 'rsc.io/fortune' go.mod

# The main module's own higher requirement wins, and needs no change.
cd $WORK/higher
go mod tidy
cp go.mod $WORK/higher.go.mod
go build ./...
cmp go.mod $WORK/higher.go.mod

# A go.sum line that disagrees with the module still fails verification.
cd $WORK/tampered
! go build ./...
stderr 'checksum mismatch'

-- $WORK/home/gopher/.gitconfig --
[user]
	name = Go Gopher
	email = gopher@golang.org
-- $WORK/alpha/go.mod --
module github.com/wow-look-at-my/alpha

go 1.21

require (
	golang.org/x/text v0.0.0-20170915032832-14c0d48ead0c // indirect
	rsc.io/quote v1.5.1
	rsc.io/sampler v1.3.0 // indirect
)
-- $WORK/alpha/alpha.go --
package alpha

import "rsc.io/quote"

func Name() string { return quote.Hello() }
-- $WORK/alpha-next/go.mod --
module github.com/wow-look-at-my/alpha

go 1.21

require (
	golang.org/x/text v0.0.0-20170915032832-14c0d48ead0c // indirect
	rsc.io/quote v1.5.2
	rsc.io/sampler v1.3.0 // indirect
)
-- $WORK/m/go.mod --
module example.com/consumer

go 1.21

require github.com/wow-look-at-my/alpha v0.0.0
-- $WORK/m/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/wow-look-at-my/alpha"
)

func main() { fmt.Println(alpha.Name()) }
-- $WORK/strict/go.mod --
module example.com/strict

go 1.21

require github.com/wow-look-at-my/alpha v0.0.0
-- $WORK/strict/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/wow-look-at-my/alpha"
)

func main() { fmt.Println(alpha.Name()) }
-- $WORK/direct/go.mod --
module example.com/direct

go 1.21

require github.com/wow-look-at-my/alpha v0.0.0
-- $WORK/direct/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/wow-look-at-my/alpha"
	"rsc.io/fortune"
)

func main() { fmt.Println(alpha.Name(), fortune.Fortune()) }
-- $WORK/higher/go.mod --
module example.com/higher

go 1.21

require (
	github.com/wow-look-at-my/alpha v0.0.0
	rsc.io/quote v1.5.2
)

require (
	golang.org/x/text v0.0.0-20170915032832-14c0d48ead0c // indirect
	rsc.io/sampler v1.3.0 // indirect
)
-- $WORK/higher/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/wow-look-at-my/alpha"
	"rsc.io/quote"
)

func main() { fmt.Println(alpha.Name(), quote.Go()) }
-- $WORK/tampered/go.mod --
module example.com/tampered

go 1.21

require github.com/wow-look-at-my/alpha v0.0.0

require (
	golang.org/x/text v0.0.0-20170915032832-14c0d48ead0c // indirect
	rsc.io/quote v1.5.1 // indirect
	rsc.io/sampler v1.3.0 // indirect
)
-- $WORK/tampered/go.sum --
rsc.io/quote v1.5.1 h1:AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA=
-- $WORK/tampered/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/wow-look-at-my/alpha"
)

func main() { fmt.Println(alpha.Name()) }
